headline: Brunson’s four-point play wins it late
dek: Tied 102–102 with 1:39 left, Jalen Brunson’s three and the free throw on a flagrant foul put the Knicks ahead for good.
three: Brunson: 31 points and the go-ahead three
7 of 7 at the line, 8 of his 31 in the fourth quarter.
